en: From Multi-Agent to AI Organizational Intelligence
zh: 从 Multi-Agent 到 AI 组织智能：下一代 AI 产品如何组织思考

excerpts.zh: 反复问多个 AI，往往是因为用户需要不同的观察角度。
excerpts.en: People often ask several AIs because they need different perspectives.

excerpts.zh: 用户缺少的可能不是答案，而是对共识和分歧的理解。
excerpts.en: People may lack an understanding of agreement and disagreement, rather than answers.

excerpts.zh: 并排展示多个模型的全文，仍把分析负担留给用户。
excerpts.en: Showing full responses side by side still leaves the analysis to the user.

excerpts.zh: 多智能体的价值取决于分工、通信和决策机制。
excerpts.en: The value of multiple agents depends on roles, communication and decision mechanisms.

excerpts.zh: 组织思考需要容纳假设、质疑、证据、反例与修正。
excerpts.en: Organizing thought requires hypotheses, challenges, evidence, counterexamples and revision.

excerpts.zh: 不是所有问题都应该追求共识。
excerpts.en: Not every question should aim for consensus.

excerpts.zh: 事实问题需要验证，价值问题需要呈现取舍。
excerpts.en: Factual questions need verification; value questions need visible trade-offs.

excerpts.zh: 过早追求一致，可能压缩创意的空间。
excerpts.en: Seeking agreement too early can narrow the space for creativity.

excerpts.zh: 组织 Agent 完成任务，和组织 Agent 帮助人思考，是不同的设计目标。
excerpts.en: Organizing agents to complete tasks and to help people think are different design goals.

excerpts.zh: 讨论什么时候停止，也需要被设计。
excerpts.en: When a discussion should stop is itself a design question.

excerpts.zh: 信息搬运可以减少，关键的价值判断仍需要人参与。
excerpts.en: Information shuffling can be reduced while people retain key value judgments.

excerpts.zh: 多智能体产品可以把分歧和待验证之处一起呈现给用户。
excerpts.en: Multi-agent products can show disagreements alongside what still needs verification.

en: Collaborative Reasoning Engine: A Product Exploration
zh: 多智能体协同思考引擎：一个面向高质量决策的 AI 产品设想

excerpts.zh: 在多个 AI 之间复制粘贴时，用户实际上承担了消息传递的工作。
excerpts.en: Copying between AIs makes the user responsible for passing messages.

excerpts.zh: 协同思考引擎的设想，是帮助用户组织观点，而不只是访问模型。
excerpts.en: The reasoning-engine concept organizes perspectives rather than merely providing model access.

excerpts.zh: 先提取观点，可以减少直接阅读多份长回答的负担。
excerpts.en: Extracting claims first can reduce the burden of reading several long responses.

excerpts.zh: 解释分歧的来源，比只统计有多少模型同意更有用。
excerpts.en: Explaining why models disagree can be more useful than counting votes.

excerpts.zh: 分歧可能来自事实、价值立场、时间尺度或风险偏好。
excerpts.en: Disagreement can arise from facts, values, time horizons or risk preferences.

excerpts.zh: 模型之间的反馈，应该比简单并列回答多提供一些价值。
excerpts.en: Feedback between models should add value beyond parallel responses.

excerpts.zh: 不同类型的问题，可以采用不同的讨论流程。
excerpts.en: Different kinds of questions can use different discussion processes.

excerpts.zh: 用户需要能够决定继续查证、保留分歧或结束讨论。
excerpts.en: Users should be able to investigate further, preserve disagreement or end the discussion.

excerpts.zh: 最小原型可以先尝试独立回答、交叉评价和观点整理。
excerpts.en: A minimal prototype can start with independent responses, cross-review and synthesis.

excerpts.zh: 模型因为相似训练数据形成的一致，不等于证据充分。
excerpts.en: Agreement caused by similar training data is not the same as strong evidence.

excerpts.zh: 多模型、多轮讨论需要考虑额外成本和等待时间。
excerpts.en: Multiple models and discussion rounds add cost and waiting time.

excerpts.zh: 评估这类产品，还要看用户是否理解分歧并保留判断权。
excerpts.en: Evaluation should ask whether users understand disagreements and retain judgment.

en: AI Organizational Intelligence: A Research Map
zh: AI 组织智能研究地图：从 Agent Workflow 到 Cognitive Workflow

excerpts.zh: 任务流程关注完成工作，认知流程还关注人如何理解与判断。
excerpts.en: Task workflows focus on execution; cognitive workflows also consider understanding and judgment.

excerpts.zh: 重复任务、输出矛盾和上下文污染，是多 Agent 的组织问题。
excerpts.en: Duplicate work, conflicting outputs and context pollution are organizational problems for agents.

excerpts.zh: 角色边界可以帮助不完美的 Agent 互相发现错误。
excerpts.en: Role boundaries can help imperfect agents catch each other’s errors.

excerpts.zh: 跨系统协作还需要权限、审计和异常处理。
excerpts.en: Cross-system collaboration also needs permissions, auditing and failure handling.

excerpts.zh: 分工可以按专业划分，也可以按认知功能划分。
excerpts.en: Roles can be divided by expertise or by cognitive function.

excerpts.zh: 让所有 Agent 看见所有消息，并不总是最好的通信方式。
excerpts.en: Letting every agent see every message is not always the best communication design.

excerpts.zh: 先独立思考再讨论，可以作为避免相互污染的一种机制。
excerpts.en: Thinking independently before discussion is one possible way to limit mutual contamination.

excerpts.zh: 多数意见与专家意见冲突时，需要明确的决策机制。
excerpts.en: Conflicts between majority and expert views require an explicit decision mechanism.

excerpts.zh: 委员会、中心调度和对立角色组织，各有不同的取舍。
excerpts.en: Committees, central coordination and rival roles involve different trade-offs.

excerpts.zh: 人应该在什么时刻介入，比笼统地说人在回路中更具体。
excerpts.en: Asking when people should intervene is more precise than simply keeping them in the loop.

excerpts.zh: 共识质量应关注证据、适用边界和不确定性。
excerpts.en: Consensus quality should consider evidence, scope and uncertainty.

excerpts.zh: 停止条件可以考虑新增信息、讨论成本和剩余分歧的性质。
excerpts.en: Stopping conditions can consider new information, cost and the nature of remaining disagreements.

en: AI Eats the Value Chain: How AI Products Displace Cognitive Labor, Not Just Competitors
zh: AI 吞噬价值链：从"信息检索"到"认知代办"的产品替代规律

excerpts.zh: AI 替代的不只是一个 App，而是用户原来的一整套信息加工行为。
excerpts.en: AI replaces not just an app, but the information work people used to do.

excerpts.zh: 综合信息这一步正在从人转移给 AI。
excerpts.en: Synthesizing information is moving from people to AI.

excerpts.zh: 把十篇文章压缩成几百字，即使没有错误，也会丢失细节。
excerpts.en: Even an accurate summary of ten articles loses detail.

excerpts.zh: 解释偏差、融合偏差和幻觉，是不同的产品设计问题。
excerpts.en: Interpretation bias, synthesis bias and hallucination need different design responses.

excerpts.zh: 有些任务需要一个足够好的答案，有些任务需要不断修正理解。
excerpts.en: Some tasks need a good enough answer; others need an evolving understanding.

excerpts.zh: 发散型任务中，对话的过程本身就有价值。
excerpts.en: In exploratory tasks, the conversation itself has value.

excerpts.zh: 分析 AI 产品时，可以先问：它替用户做掉了哪部分认知劳动？
excerpts.en: To analyze an AI product, ask which cognitive work it takes over.

excerpts.zh: 当规划被自动化，真人体验仍然可能成为判断的依据。
excerpts.en: When planning is automated, first-hand experience can still support judgment.

excerpts.zh: 知识管理工具可能从存储知识，转向支持思考。
excerpts.en: Knowledge tools may shift from storing information to supporting thought.

excerpts.zh: 生成演示文稿变容易后，想清楚要讲什么仍然重要。
excerpts.en: When making slides gets easier, deciding what to say still matters.

excerpts.zh: 提出目标、承担责任和价值判断，并不会随信息处理自动化而消失。
excerpts.en: Goals, responsibility and value judgments do not disappear when information processing is automated.

excerpts.zh: 下一代产品也许需要比较：谁能帮助人形成更好的判断？
excerpts.en: The next product question may be: who helps people make better judgments?

en: AI Insurance: Frameworks, Application Cases, and Market Trends
zh: AI保险：责任框架、应用案例与市场趋势

excerpts.zh: 当 AI 获得决策权，责任如何划分也成为产品问题。
excerpts.en: As AI gains decision-making power, allocating responsibility becomes a product question.

excerpts.zh: 自动决策的失误可能来自硬件、软件、网络或人机交接。
excerpts.en: Failures in automated decisions can involve hardware, software, networks or human handovers.

excerpts.zh: 分析责任时，需要区分系统自主运行和人应当接管的时刻。
excerpts.en: Responsibility analysis needs to distinguish autonomous operation from expected human intervention.

excerpts.zh: AI 的幻觉、偏见与未经授权的操作，会带来不同类型的损失。
excerpts.en: Hallucinations, bias and unauthorized actions create different kinds of loss.

excerpts.zh: 当运行日志由厂商独自掌控，定责证据也会面临信任问题。
excerpts.en: When vendors alone control operational logs, evidence about responsibility raises trust questions.

excerpts.zh: 模型的随机性让风险评估与保险定价更难稳定下来。
excerpts.en: Model variability makes risk assessment and insurance pricing harder to stabilize.

en: Tracking App Install Sources on Android with the Play Install Referrer Library
zh: 使用 Play Install Referrer 库在 Android 上追踪应用安装来源

excerpts.zh: 安装来源追踪把推广链接和应用首次安装连接起来。
excerpts.en: Install attribution connects a campaign link with an app installation.

excerpts.zh: 渠道参数进入应用后，才能用于后续的转化分析。
excerpts.en: Campaign parameters must reach the app before they can support conversion analysis.

excerpts.zh: 连接 Google Play 是异步过程，需要分别处理成功、不支持和服务不可用。
excerpts.en: Connecting to Google Play is asynchronous and requires handling different outcomes.

excerpts.zh: 连接断开后，需要考虑如何重新建立连接。
excerpts.en: A disconnected service needs a reconnection strategy.

excerpts.zh: 读取来源信息后，应当释放连接和相关资源。
excerpts.en: After reading attribution data, release the connection and associated resources.

excerpts.zh: 本地安装和经 Google Play 下载的安装，需要用不同场景验证。
excerpts.en: Local installs and Google Play installs need separate test scenarios.

excerpts.zh: 本地 ONNX 模型优先，云端识别提供第二份参考结果。
excerpts.en: The local ONNX model comes first; cloud recognition provides a second result.

excerpts.zh: 识别动物和获取百科介绍，可以交给不同的服务完成。
excerpts.en: Animal recognition and encyclopedia retrieval can use separate services.

excerpts.zh: Gemini 返回动物名称后，应用再检索维基百科简介。
excerpts.en: After Gemini returns an animal name, the app retrieves its Wikipedia introduction.

excerpts.zh: 图像和文字提示一起构成多模态识别请求。
excerpts.en: An image and a text prompt form the multimodal recognition request.

excerpts.zh: 发起网络请求前，先检查是否已经有远程识别结果。
excerpts.en: Before making a network request, check whether a remote result is already available.

excerpts.zh: 加载状态、结果解析和界面更新，也是识别流程的一部分。
excerpts.en: Loading states, response parsing and UI updates are part of the recognition flow.

en: When AI Becomes a Cognitive Partner: The Limits of Linear Chat and the Search for Non-Linear Interfaces
zh: 当 AI 成为认知伙伴：线性对话的困境与非线性界面的探索

excerpts.zh: 思维可以同时分叉，线性聊天却要求问题依次排队。
excerpts.en: Thought can branch in several directions; linear chat makes questions queue up.

excerpts.zh: 注意力结构、上下文污染和导航负担，是三个不同的问题。
excerpts.en: Attention structure, context pollution and navigation burden are distinct problems.

excerpts.zh: 创建新聊天保留了分支，却不一定提供持续可见的结构。
excerpts.en: Starting a new chat preserves a branch without necessarily making its structure visible.

excerpts.zh: LatentLearn 先选择了一个具体场景：有明确主题的聚焦学习。
excerpts.en: LatentLearn starts with a specific case: focused learning around a clear topic.

excerpts.zh: 每个分支只继承必要的祖先上下文，而不是整段聊天历史。
excerpts.en: Each branch inherits relevant ancestor context rather than the entire chat history.

excerpts.zh: 节点的标题与摘要用来定位，完整内容留到需要时展开。
excerpts.en: Titles and summaries support navigation; full content opens when needed.

excerpts.zh: 当分支不断增加，树本身也可能成为新的导航负担。
excerpts.en: As branches multiply, the tree itself can become a navigation burden.

excerpts.zh: 完全自动判断偏题可能打断探索，完全手动管理又增加整理成本。
excerpts.en: Automatic topic decisions can interrupt exploration; manual control adds organizational work.

excerpts.zh: 树擅长发散，却不会自然告诉你最终理解了什么。
excerpts.en: Trees support exploration but do not automatically reveal what you learned.

excerpts.zh: 一个问题可能来自两个父节点，纯粹的树表达不了所有联系。
excerpts.en: A question can arise from two parent nodes; a tree cannot represent every connection.

excerpts.zh: 探索、阅读、记忆和表达，可能需要不同的信息结构。
excerpts.en: Exploration, reading, memory and expression may need different structures.

excerpts.zh: 真正值得设计的，是不同认知状态之间如何流畅转换。
excerpts.en: The design challenge is moving smoothly between different cognitive states.

en: Paper Review: Tracking Political Biases in NLP Models
zh: 论文评述：追踪NLP模型中的政治偏见

excerpts.zh: 不同语言模型面对敏感问题时的态度差异，引出了这次论文阅读。
excerpts.en: Differences in models’ responses to sensitive questions prompted this paper review.

excerpts.zh: 这篇论文追踪偏见如何从预训练数据传递到下游任务。
excerpts.en: The reviewed paper traces bias from pretraining data to downstream tasks.

excerpts.zh: 量化模型立场，需要先明确测量框架。
excerpts.en: Quantifying model positions requires an explicit measurement framework.

excerpts.zh: 编码器模型与生成式模型，需要不同的立场测量方法。
excerpts.en: Encoder-only and generative models require different methods for measuring stance.

excerpts.zh: 整体性能指标之外，还需要观察不同群体的表现差异。
excerpts.en: Beyond aggregate performance, evaluation should examine differences across groups.

excerpts.zh: 模型对与自身立场一致的信息，可能表现出不同的判断倾向。
excerpts.en: Models may judge information aligned with their positions differently.

excerpts.zh: 特定语料与实验环境中的结论，不一定直接推广到其他场景。
excerpts.en: Conclusions from particular corpora and experiments may not generalize to other settings.

excerpts.zh: 研究公平性时，复现与更广泛的数据验证同样重要。
excerpts.en: Fairness research also needs replication and validation on broader data.

zh: 从“抠得干净”到“真的可用”：一次图像模型评测实践
en: From clean cutouts to usable results: evaluating image models

excerpts.zh: 先定义用户想得到什么，再决定如何评价模型。
excerpts.en: Define what users want before deciding how to evaluate a model.

excerpts.zh: 产品规则不清与模型能力不足需要分开处理。
excerpts.en: Unclear product rules and model limitations need to be addressed separately.

excerpts.zh: 诊断样本适合发现问题，但不能直接代表线上分布。
excerpts.en: Diagnostic samples reveal problems but do not directly represent the production distribution.

excerpts.zh: 自动指标与人工评审共同支持对产品可用性的判断。
excerpts.en: Automatic metrics and human review jointly inform judgments about product usability.

excerpts.zh: 参考标注和样本归组争议需要先于模型输赢结论解决。
excerpts.en: Disputes about reference annotations and sample assignments need resolving before declaring a model winner.

excerpts.zh: 实验环境中的耗时不能替代端侧真机性能测试。
excerpts.en: Experimental runtimes do not substitute for on-device performance testing.

en: When Land Becomes Cheap, What Will We Actually Own?
zh: 当土地不再稀缺，我们真正拥有的是什么？

excerpts.zh: 一个房间可以被重新配置的短视频，引出了对未来居住的想象。
excerpts.en: A video of a reconfigurable room prompted an imagined future of living spaces.

excerpts.zh: 如果空间不再是约束，改造空间的能力会不会更珍贵？
excerpts.en: If space stops being the constraint, does the ability to reshape it become more valuable?

excerpts.zh: 未来的家，也许可以把物理组件和视觉皮肤分开。
excerpts.en: A future home might separate physical components from its visual appearance.

excerpts.zh: AR 叠加在真实环境上，保留了身体与物理世界的联系。
excerpts.en: AR overlays the real environment while preserving contact with the physical world.

excerpts.zh: 如果家的组件是硬件，它们的排列方式是软件，会怎样？
excerpts.en: What if a home’s components were hardware and their arrangement were software?

excerpts.zh: 空间也许会拥有版本号，房间也许会拥有更新日志。
excerpts.en: Spaces might have version numbers; rooms might have changelogs.

excerpts.zh: 可重构的材料不等于可重构的生活，能源仍是现实约束。
excerpts.en: Reconfigurable materials do not guarantee reconfigurable living; energy remains a constraint.

excerpts.zh: 一个能适应你的空间，同时也是一个在观察你的空间。
excerpts.en: A space that adapts to you is also a space that observes you.

excerpts.zh: 在重新排列之前，空间应该先征得你的同意吗？
excerpts.en: Should a space ask permission before rearranging itself?

excerpts.zh: 当家没有固定形态，附着在某个角落的记忆要放在哪里？
excerpts.en: When a home has no fixed form, where do memories tied to a corner belong?

excerpts.zh: 交互设计也需要问：怎样让技术可以被人居住？
excerpts.en: Interaction design can also ask: how can technology become inhabitable?

excerpts.zh: 这篇随笔想象的是空间从财产变成媒介的可能性。
excerpts.en: This essay imagines space changing from property into a medium.

en: Industry Survey: The Present and Future of Intelligent Robotics
zh: 行业调查：智能机器人的现状与未来

excerpts.zh: 机器人进入日常生活时，需要同时考虑技术与社会影响。
excerpts.en: Robots entering everyday life raise both technical and social questions.

excerpts.zh: 养老陪伴和日常照料，让机器人设计与人的生活需求直接相遇。
excerpts.en: Companionship and everyday care connect robot design directly with human needs.

excerpts.zh: 不同文化对机器人参与情感交互的接受程度可能不同。
excerpts.en: Acceptance of emotional interaction with robots may vary across cultures.

excerpts.zh: 理解人的情感和回应方式，是人机交互的一部分。
excerpts.en: Understanding and responding to human emotion is part of human–robot interaction.

excerpts.zh: 高能耗是机器人走向更广泛应用时需要面对的约束。
excerpts.en: Energy consumption constrains the broader use of robotics.

excerpts.zh: 讨论机器人发展，也需要讨论伦理、责任与社会效益。
excerpts.en: Discussing robotics also means considering ethics, responsibility and social benefit.

en: When Technology Truly "Disappears": Reflections on Reading Weiser's The Computer for the 21st Century
zh: 当技术真正“消失”：阅读维瑟《21世纪的计算机》的心得与反思

excerpts.zh: 一件发热马甲，也能成为理解隐形计算的入口。
excerpts.en: A heated vest can be an entry point for understanding invisible computing.

excerpts.zh: 技术融入生活，不一定要以一台显眼的设备出现。
excerpts.en: Technology can fit into life without appearing as a conspicuous device.

excerpts.zh: 熟悉的文字会直接呈现意义，陌生语言却需要额外解码。
excerpts.en: Familiar writing conveys meaning directly; an unfamiliar language needs extra decoding.

excerpts.zh: 在德国看路牌的经历，让我想到技术的认知门槛。
excerpts.en: Reading street signs in Germany made me think about technology’s cognitive barriers.

excerpts.zh: 普适计算的愿景，是让技术在环境中提供帮助，而不是持续占据注意力。
excerpts.en: Ubiquitous computing imagines technology helping from the environment rather than constantly demanding attention.

excerpts.zh: 联网设备需要人反复配置时，计算还没有真正退到背景。
excerpts.en: When networked devices need repeated configuration, computing has not faded into the background.

excerpts.zh: 理解新概念时，熟悉的产品类比也可能误导我们。
excerpts.en: Familiar product analogies can mislead us when learning a new concept.

excerpts.zh: 把 Tabs 当作 AirTags，会忽略它作为交互媒介的设想。
excerpts.en: Equating Tabs with AirTags misses their envisioned role as interaction media.

excerpts.zh: 共享文件和共享一个协作空间，并不完全相同。
excerpts.en: Sharing a file and sharing a collaborative space are not quite the same.

excerpts.zh: 联网不自动等于环境中的设备能够动态协作。
excerpts.en: Being connected does not automatically mean devices can cooperate dynamically in an environment.

excerpts.zh: 当 AI 替人操作，依赖人浏览的商业模式也会受到影响。
excerpts.en: When AI acts for people, business models that depend on human browsing are affected.

excerpts.zh: 技术退到背景之后，人的选择权更需要被看见。
excerpts.en: When technology fades into the background, human choice needs to remain visible.

zh: 换一种语言，模型的判断会改变吗？
en: Does changing the language change a model’s judgment?

excerpts.zh: 多语言产品需要在翻译检查之外检验行为一致性。
excerpts.en: Multilingual products need behavioral consistency checks alongside translation checks.

excerpts.zh: 具体伦理场景帮助把抽象的立场问题转化为可评测的输入。
excerpts.en: Concrete ethical scenarios turn abstract questions about stance into testable inputs.

excerpts.zh: 裁判之间的一致性不等同于客观真值。
excerpts.en: Agreement between judges is not objective ground truth.

excerpts.zh: 从激活中预测立场，不等于找到了控制立场的机制。
excerpts.en: Predicting stance from activations does not establish a mechanism that controls it.

excerpts.zh: 相关性提出候选解释，干预实验检验解释的边界。
excerpts.en: Correlation proposes candidate explanations; intervention tests their limits.

excerpts.zh: 无显著效果的结果同样能帮助划清结论边界。
excerpts.en: Non-significant results also help define what the evidence can support.
